---
name: Part bug report
about: Report a problem with an existing PRPOL part
title: "[Part bug] "
labels: part-bug
---

## Which part?

File name and module, e.g. `plate/flat.scad`, module `flat()`.

## What went wrong?

Describe the problem: bad fit, geometry error, render failure, or
documentation issue.

## How to reproduce

- Parameters used (if non-default)
- Slicer / printer settings if relevant
- Screenshots or photos welcome

## Environment

- OpenSCAD version
- Operating system
